noun_definition: Hold refers to the action of temporarily suspending or pausing expenses in the context of a workspace report, preventing them from being processed until they are released or "unheld."
Unhold refers to the option that should be available on the report details of a held expense, allowing users to release the hold on that expense after it has been moved to a new report offline.

Report header refers to the section at the top of the report that displays details about the report, including the held expenses, and is expected to provide an "Unhold" option for those expenses after they are moved to a new report offline.

Held expense refers to an expense that has been temporarily set aside and is awaiting further action, specifically in the context of being included in a new report offline without the option to "Unhold" it.
Report refers to a collection of expenses that have been submitted and organized within the workspace, specifically highlighting those that include held expenses in this context.
offline refers to the state in which the user is not connected to the internet while interacting with the expense report system.
